From: Polybius the Grand (user-tier). For: Polybius the Stoa. Author: Denson Smith.

CONTEXT: Setup notes for the stoagen personal-builder-space GCP service account + APIs (Pliny the Stoa is walking PRINCIPAL through the setup now). Current needs: Maps (all), Gemini embeddings, grounded search. Soon: Google Earth Engine (PRINCIPAL wants it on a SEPARATE billing account). Plus the non-Google APIs for the scienceclaw refactor. Relates to sos--373 (secure-core requirement) + stoa--q7f (the inc-2.4 secure-core DESIGN gauntlet, in flight) + u--9s2 (cookie-cutter). These notes should feed the stoa--q7f design AND the live stoagen provisioning Pliny is running now.

1. SA COVERS VERTEX, NOT MAPS -- two different auth models. The service account authenticates Vertex AI (embeddings + grounded search + generative). Google Maps Platform does NOT use service accounts -- it uses API keys. Enable aiplatform.googleapis.com for the SA path; mint Maps keys separately.

2. PUT EMBEDDINGS AND SEARCH ON VERTEX via the SA -- not the legacy AI-Studio API-key path. Standalone Gemini API keys are being retired (science fork verified via gsearch: unrestricted stopped 2026-06-19; standard keys rejected ~Sept 2026). Vertex+SA is future-proof and matches the working zeotek_newswire pattern (Vertex+ADC on denso-substrate). Consolidate embeddings + gsearch onto Vertex+SA.

3. LEAST-PRIVILEGE THE SA: roles/aiplatform.user only (NOT owner/editor). Prefer Workload Identity Federation over a downloadable JSON key for the Railway core if feasible; otherwise the SA key lives in the core's secret store, never on the builder.

4. RESTRICT THE MAPS KEY(S) HARD -- likely TWO: a referrer-restricted BROWSER key (served map HTML, origindex/cartograph style) + an IP-restricted SERVER key (the core's Geocoding/Static/Places calls). Restrict each by API to only the Maps APIs actually used. Unrestricted Maps keys get scraped and run up the bill.

5. BILLING IS THE ONLY REAL CAP. GCP has no hard spend ceiling (alerts only) -- the prepaid card on stoagen's billing account IS the cap (per the per-builder card+billing spend-cap model). Earth Engine on a SEPARATE billing account is correct (lumpy spend + its own access model) -- isolate it on its own project + prepaid card. Mechanic: a separate billing account needs its own GCP project to attach to.

6. EVERYTHING MINTED IS DESTINED FOR THE SECURE CORE (sos--373), not the laptop. SA key + Maps key(s) + scienceclaw API keys all live on the core, reached over Tailscale; the builder holds only a tailnet identity. If minted before the core exists, they sit in the local keyring temporarily -- plan their home as the core.

7. SCIENCECLAW'S OTHER KEYS ARE SEPARATE FROM THIS SA. The ~46 keyed scienceclaw skills mostly need NON-Google keys (NCBI, Materials Project, HuggingFace, UN Comtrade -- free; SerpAPI/OpenRouter/etc. -- paid) -- separate secrets the core holds, NOT roles on the GCP SA. For Google specifically, scienceclaw needs only Vertex (embeddings/generative for the KG pipeline); don't widen the SA scope for it.

DISCIPLINE: Google auth specifics move fast (Vertex key-deprecation dates, EE access steps, exact role names). gsearch-confirm against current Google docs at the moment of setup -- do not trust memory (mine included). credential-discipline holds: the agent never holds or sees the secrets; minting the SA + setting keys is the out-of-band human step.

title: [for: Polybius the Stoa] stoagen GCP service-account + APIs + billing — Grand's setup notes (feeds stoa--q7f)
